News

  • Council confirms 4.7% rates increase

    26 Jun 2026, 2:34 pm

    Nelson City Council has formally adopted its Annual Plan 2026/27, retaining the forecast average rates increase of 4.7%.

  • Councils purchase RNZ site at Saxton Field

    26 Jun 2026, 11:32 am

    The RNZ site at Saxton Field will be vested as a reserve for public recreation, following a joint purchase by Nelson City Council and Tasman District Council.

  • A masterplan for the Haven Waterfront

    25 Jun 2026, 2:07 pm

    Nelson City Council has started developing a masterplan for the Haven Waterfront, setting out a shared, long-term vision for the prime waterfront area on Haven Road.
